<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **147** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fbc16563a65f0352527ea97aaf55c540e89ae4da` → `packageMentionDocs`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2cb3badac9d517d0729bd62e57594aba48ff3b42`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts + .changeset/26170-translation-data-comment-count.md, and every sentence that spells a translation-group count in content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx, content/docs/ui/translations.mdx and content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx (read, none moved)

Round 1, follow-up of #26170, on a moved head. The brief named `bcc7555980`; the PR's head was `2cb3badac9` by the time the first reading was complete (one commit added at 02:29:28Z, the changeset), so this record reviews `2cb3badac9` and says so. Inputs read by GET: the PR body (both readings, the second with the two changeset lines replaced), the file list (2 paths at this head, 1 at the old one), the net diff against `main` at each head, the one PR comment (docs-drift 6458991770), the PR's two commits, the check-runs on both heads at the times stated below; #26831's body and its round-4 contract review 6458660736 (the source of this PR); #26819's body; `translation.zod.ts` at the head (the blob is `26b209a5cc` at both heads, so one read covers both); and a read-only `git grep` over the local `origin/main` checkout (`c79eda5ed5`, which contains the #26831 merge `b3f73445f4`). Nothing checked out, built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**The new word is true.** `appTranslationDataShape()` at this head (lines 911–1964) declares exactly sixteen top-level keys, read off the code: `objects`, `picklists`, `apps`, `messages`, `globalActions`, `dashboards`, `datasets`, `reports`, `pages`, `flows`, `hooks`, `positions`, `permissions`, `books`, `metadataForms`, `settingsCommon`. `TranslationDataSchema` (line 2088) spreads that shape and nothing else, so "Sixteen groups: every group the platform bundle declares EXCEPT `settings`" is the code's count. `platformSettingsShape()` (lines 1995–2076) declares one key, `settings`; `PlatformTranslationDataSchema` spreads both shapes, so the "seventeen-group face" three lines below the hunk is true too. The PR body's key list matches the code's, in the code's order.

**Every other spelled count in the file agrees with the code at this head.** Read line by line: 747 (`PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY`, "the sixteen groups this bundle does declare", followed by the sixteen names in declaration order), 792 (`ITEM_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY`, "the same sixteen a per-app bundle declares"), 831/835/836 (the shape's docblock: "Sixteen groups — the seventeenth, `settings`", "these sixteen and no more", "these sixteen plus `settings`"), 2082 (this PR's line), 2085 ("the seventeen-group face"), 2106 (`PlatformTranslationDataSchema`: "the seventeen groups, `settings` included"), 2309 (`TranslationItemSchema`: "the same sixteen groups as `TranslationDataSchema`"). No `.describe()` string in the file spells a count (the two faces' describes are "Per-app translation data for objects, apps, and UI messages" and "Platform translation data — the per-app groups plus the platform-only `settings`"). `ServedTranslationDataSchema` (sixteen: the platform face minus `metadataForms`) spells no count anywhere. Sibling schemas in `packages/spec/src/system/` spell none for translation groups (`git grep` of the spelled numbers fourteen–eighteen over `packages/spec/src`, `content/docs`, `ui/packages/i18n`, the app-shell metadata-admin tree, the cli i18n walkers, the lint rule and the walk-parity fixture: every hit outside `translation.zod.ts` is about something else).

**The docs agree.** `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` lists the sixteen groups by name (lines 407–410, `hooks` and `books` both present, in declaration order) and says "one of the sixteen declared groups" (line 499). `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` spells no count; its key table carries a hook-refusals row (the `hooks` group, keyed by hook) and a doc-book row (the `books` group, keyed by book name). `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx` is generated from `.describe()` and the module docblock, not from per-export TSDoc (`build-docs.ts` → `lib/file-description.ts` `findModuleDocBlock`; property rows from `.describe()`), spells no count, and its `PlatformTranslationData` section lists the seventeen nested shapes including `hooks`, `books` and `settings`. Nothing this PR should have fixed in the same round is left stale: the #26831 review named exactly one line, and that line is the hunk.

**Generated output does not move.** The changed line is a `/** */` comment on an exported const, not a `.describe()`, a refusal sentence or the module docblock, so `check:docs`, `check:authorable-surface` and the `json-schema.manifest` read nothing from it; `check:api-surface` records that the export exists, not its comment. The gate's own verdict is `Type Check · source gates` (`check:generated --reconcile-only`) on this head, read under ③ below. The docs-drift comment 6458991770 says the path yielded no anchor, which is consistent with a change no documentable surface derives from, and is not a clean bill; the hand re-read above is the compensating read.

**The changeset was owed, and the first head did not carry it.** At `bcc7555980` the PR added no changeset and carried no `skip-changeset` label, and the body said "comment-only, no changeset". `Check Changeset` on that head concluded `failure` at 02:28:50Z (read at 02:31:39Z); the three other reds on that head (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test UI`) concluded after their child jobs were `cancelled` at 02:29:56Z–02:30:54Z, i.e. after the 02:29:28Z push superseded the head, and are read as cancellations, not verdicts. The rule the gate enforces is AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3: a changeset for anything that publishes, and `skip-changeset` only for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package. A TSDoc comment on an exported const in `packages/spec/src` ships in the published `dist/*.d.ts`, so it publishes; the dev's reading that a comment publishes nothing was wrong under this repo's gate, and the second commit corrects it rather than routing around it with the label. `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` says in its own header that it is deliberately "not 'skip if the diff is comment-only'"; this PR now matches that posture.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/26170-translation-data-comment-count.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, body carrying `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` as line-initial declarations, matching the PR body's two lines byte for byte. Right at this head: the diff changes no accept set, key, value, default or meaning, so the kind is `none`, and `none` takes `patch` (AGENTS.md step 3). No `(widening)`/`(narrowing)` arm, so no ADR-0087 marker is owed and no `!`. `@objectstack/spec` is in the repo's fixed group (`.changeset/config.json`), so the release's level is decided by the group; a `patch` line on one member is the correct declaration for this change. The `Skills-docs:` line (`none, because no skills/** file states the per-app group count`) is owed only when the kind is other than `none` or a `(narrowing)` arm is present (pm-dispatch review-checklist); here it is surplus and true — `git grep` of the spelled counts over `skills/**` returns nothing about translation groups. No governed path in the diff (`Governed Surface Queue Guard`: `success` on both heads).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Gate readings on `2cb3badac9`, read at 2026-10-28T02:33:59Z (43 check-runs; 15 `success`, 9 `skipped`, 19 `in_progress`, 0 red, 0 cancelled).** Concluded `success`: `Check Changeset` (both runs, 02:31:26Z and 02:32:22Z — the gate the old head failed), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Spec property liveness`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Flag docs affected by code changes`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` (umbrella), `Auto Label`, `filter`. Still `in_progress` at the reading, four minutes after the push: `Build Core`, `Build UI Deps`, the eight `Test Core` shards, `Type Check · source gates` (the job that carries `check:generated --reconcile-only` and `check:docs`), `Type Check · consumer gates` / `debt ledger` / `workspace`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, the two scoped lint jobs; their umbrellas (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`) had not been created yet. An in_progress gate is a reading, not a pass: this record judges the contract (①, ②) and vouches for no gate it did not read as `success`; the landing waits on the eight required contexts concluding `success` on this head, and a required context concluding otherwise supersedes this reading and reopens the review. The reasoning in ① predicts `Type Check · source gates` green (nothing generated reads a per-export TSDoc); that prediction is not a reading.
- **Head moved during review, recorded above.** `bcc7555980` → `2cb3badac9`, one added file (`.changeset/26170-translation-data-comment-count.md`, +10) and the body's two changeset lines rewritten; `translation.zod.ts` is the same blob at both heads. The brief's sha is reviewed as the parent of this head, not as the head.
- **Body `Verification` claim.** "`check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset` pass locally" is the dev's claim; the gate verdicts are `Check Changeset` and `Lint & Repo Gates` on this head, read above, not the claim.
- **Nothing published or user-read moved.** The one TSDoc word reaches `dist/*.d.ts` only (hover text in an editor); no refusal sentence, describe, JSON Schema, generated doc or test changes. No follow-up is owed by this PR.
- **PR is `draft: true`, `mergeable_state: blocked` at every read.** Landing state is the lane seat's; read, not judged.

- **What failed:** `@objectstack/rest#test`, one test only. `packages/rest/src/data-nested-object-door.test.ts:288`, "the cap: a condition matching more related records than the cap is REFUSED, never truncated; at the cap it is served whole" (sqlite), failed with `Test timed out in 5000ms`. There is no assertion diff; 6546 other tests in the shard passed.
- **Why it is not this PR's:** this PR changes one word in a TSDoc comment in `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` and adds a changeset. Neither reaches `packages/rest` or the objectql delete path at run time. The test inserts and then deletes 1,001 related rows against a 5 s budget, and #27004 (open, p1) already records that since #26930 a predicate delete walks every matched row one by one, which brings this exact test near its 5 s budget under load. The same workflow's `Test Core` lanes are green on main's latest runs (`cb8988ee14`, `c79eda5ed5`).
- **Fix:** none exists yet. #27004 is dispatched but has no fix PR, so there is nothing to port into this PR.
